title: Indian state government subsidies
definition: Total revenue expenditure classified as subsidies by Indian State Governments and Union Territories with legislatures, compiled by the Reserve Bank of India from state budget documents.

sources.title: State Finances: A Study of Budgets of 2025-26 — Statement 36: Subsidies
